limitations: Local production-build evidence only; deployment/live results belong to primary RELEASES/03, not this immutable receipt.
Post scores are source-affordance heuristics capped at 75, not 400 executed tasks or a real-user CX score.
Scopes identify conservative source transfer with stated devices/entries/flags; tablet, screen-reader/zoom and unlisted conditions are not newly graded.
Real users observed zero; no demand, retention, conversion or willingness-to-pay inference.
UAE/payment eligibility unresolved; no checkout activation or real charge.
Calculation reference parity, historical/DST/interval sensitivity and predictive validity not established.
Visual/contrast/screen-reader grades remain unknown; no-overlay/overflow screenshots are not full accessibility tests.
Account/export/delete tests use isolated mocks, not real data operations, DB restoration or a transactional rollback.
Analytics transport is intercepted/mocked; existing provider events and inaccessible third-party cookies are not proven erased.
Walkthrough actual video playback/captions/transcript tested separately in 33-task report; no requested natural presenter produced.
